posts.title: I Spent $1000 Making LLMs Play Competitive Pokémon
posts.description: We ran a round-robin Pokémon Showdown tournament between ten frontier and open-weight model configurations, then read 26,220 of their decisions to see how they predict, bluff and sacrifice.

posts.title: Throughputmaxxing DeepSeek V4 Flash on TPU v6e
posts.description: What it took to serve DeepSeek-V4-Flash on TPU v6e (Trillium): 4-bit experts on a chip without 4-bit types, accuracy gates that caught a fake f32 all-reduce, latency-bound collectives, and the kernels that fixed each one. Then decode speed by concurrency, and the cost of one 8-chip prefill host feeding 64 decode chips.
